summary: fix(wework): materialize full live dogfood contracts
reason: Full live dogfood needed stable Austin search and geo fixtures, a non-personal booking-details fixture with a typed not-found result, runnable feedback examples, and an explicit error-path opt-out for free-form feedback where every non-empty string is valid input. The metadata is materialized in a hand-authored command-tree overlay and the archived OpenAPI source without editing generated files marked DO NOT EDIT.
validated_outcome: Printing Press full live dogfood passed 122/122 authenticated tests with zero failures and no hollow feature coverage. Destructive operations remained disabled; the booking fixture uses a stable typed not-found result instead of account-specific reservation data.
